summary: HBT Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K/A to provide audited financial statements of acquired CNB Bank Shares, Inc. and pro forma financial information, completing the acquisition of CNB on March 1, 2026. The Merger was executed under an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated October 20, 2025, between HBT Financial, CNB, and a wholly-owned merger subsidiary. The filing does not disclose specific deal terms such as price per share, premium, or consideration. The unaudited pro forma condensed combined balance sheet and income statement as of and for the year ended December 31, 2025, are included. This amendment supplements the initial Form 8-K filed on March 2, 2026, addressing Item 9.01 requirements. What to watch: integration execution and potential cost savings as the combined entity operates; no regulatory overhang remains as the deal has closed.
